_comment: Representative first-user-turn prompts in the style sampled from WildChat-1M (Zhao et al., 2024). The paper samples 20 prompts x 40 samples each. The three examples explicitly quoted in Appendix B are included verbatim (typos preserved). The remainder are hand-written stand-ins matching WildChat's everyday-help register so the bundled run is self-contained; set --wildchat-source hf to draw the real 20-prompt sample instead. See DESIGN.md.
